profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at ConcertVDC, Inc.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Developer who was dedicated to building products that positioned the company for future subscription customers and for securing investment financing.

- Wrote the software to extract historian data in the PoC that led to the initial angel investment and official founding of the company.

- Spearheaded the efforts in Arundo getting accepted as a part of the Stanford affiliated ​StartX​ program. Program included access to the StartX network with other startups as well as an additional 10% investment from the program to the last round raised ($400K off of a $4M loan).

- Solidified a strategic investment from Microsoft through forms and direct contact with representatives that resulted in a $300K credit on their Azure platform.

- Worked on various products (DeepQ, Enterprise, Dashboards, Marathon) across all points of the development. Built front-end web client interfaces with a ReactJS base framework, developed back-end server side endpoints in various languages (Golang/nodeJS/Elixir/C#), and utilized various Databases (Azure Cosmos/Azure Postgres/TimescaleDB) for data storage

- Investigated the use of TimescaleDB and migrated to using it from raw Postgres in order to perform time series lookup of data ranging in the 10s of gigs, reducing query times from min to seconds.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Was in charge of building Natera Connect, the clinic portal that allows doctors to release prenatal/genetic screening results to their patients. Also managed and maintained the internal billing and financial systems.

- Built a new web application to replace the old Natera Connect system.

- Helped to maintain the internal legacy billing and financial systems.

- Responsible for maintaining the various test ordering forms, ensuring that the application adhered to HL7 and
other standards.

positions.title: Developer Lead
positions.description:
Lead development and engineers within HatTrick/Lightyear Studio to build Words of Wonder, a web-based game for Facebook, as well as game features. Built and continue to maintain Java Web Server as well as front end game features for various game actions and player state storage. Interface with Producers/Product Managers to design the feature specifications and estimate task breakdown/build time. Built back end game logic, in Java, related to user actions and player data persistence.

-	Propelled Words of Wonder game to current user retention of 804K Daily Active Users (DAU) worldwide across Facebook, Android and iOS, with average monthly revenue of $1M.

-	Overcame obstacle of only two dedicated engineers on project, building both front end (Flash/ActionScript) and back end game servers and changing over language port of code from Lua into Java within six weeks.

-	Cut server costs by 88%, for a savings of $220K monthly, through changeover of back end systems from Lua to Java server after initial Alpha test launch. 

-	Ensured operational game while minimizing maintenance costs by continually adjusting number of live servers to avert under- and over-provisioning.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Mountain View and Palo Alto, California, United States
positions.description:
Developed web games and  features on Facebook and MySpace, including Mobsters and Sorority Life. Developed web application prototypes for You++/Playdom (acquired by Disney in 2010).  Built Mobsters 2, a sequel to Mobsters on Facebook for front end game logic, game layout, back end game commands and player state recording.


-	Contributed to Playdom securing first round of funding in the fall of 2009 by exceeding revenue goals through developed game features, particularly Mobsters 2, one of the most successful games in Playdom history.

-	Minimized time from conception to release of Mobsters 2 by developing front-end architecture, creating mass amounts of code and game features in only two months.

-	Collaborated with the creators of Triple Town as part of a Playdom/SpryFox publishing venture.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer at YouPlusPlus.  YouPlusPlus became Playdom in March 2009.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Created and developed online marketplace to facilitate product placement agreements between marketers and content producers. sUtilized OOP paradigms in a 3-tier web architecture to allow information processing from client to backend through C# and LLBLGen.

- Increased speed of web experience and eliminated lengthy page loading times by transitioning development from Microsoft system/Telerik to a more streamlined system with ExtJs and ScriptSharp.

- Hired as a front end developer, but learned how to create server-side code in C#, use MS SQL and interface with C# code using the Object-to-Relational mapping system, LLBLGen.
